name: Autumn Hora Queen
body:
AUTUMN HORA QUEEN
CR 13

This beautiful woman dances among the falling leaves without leaving a trace; her hair, skin, and eyes match the green, gold, brown, and red of the autumn trees, as do the veils she wears.

XP 25,600
CG Medium fey
Init +9; Senses low-light vision; Perception +28
Aura stunning beauty (30 ft., DC 27)

DEFENSE

AC 28, touch 16, flat-footed 22 (+5 Dex, +1 dodge, +12 natural)
hp 187(22d6+110)
Fort +14, Ref +18, Will +16
DR 10/cold iron; Immune energy drain and negative energy effects
Weaknesses autumn bound

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee 2 autumn sickles +17 (3d6+5 slashing +3d6 negative energy)
Ranged 2 rays of decay +17 (6d8 negative energy)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 20th; concentration +16)

Constant—speak with animals, speak with plants
At will—know direction, pass without trace, purify food and drink
1/day—animal messenger, bestow curse (DC 20), commune with nature, faerie fire, finger of death (DC 24), goodberry, true seeing

Druid Spells Prepared (CL 13th; concentration +16)

7th-level—control weather
6th-level—dust form, liveoak
5th-level—baleful polymorph (DC 18), touch of slumber (DC 18), tree stride
4th-level—explosion of rot (DC 18), freedom of movement, giant vermin, vermin shape II
3rd-level—cloak of winds, fungal infestations (DC 17), neutralize poison, protection from energy, vermin shape I
2nd-level—fog cloud, harvest season, stone call, summon nature’s ally II, tree shape
1st-level—calm animals (DC 14), endothermic touch (DC 14), hibernate, longstrider, thorn javelin
0th-level—detect magic, guidance, resistance, stabilize

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 21, Con 20, Int 17, Wis 17, Cha 22
Base Atk +11; CMB +16, CMD 29
Feats Agile Maneuvers, Combat Casting, Dodge, Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Mobility, Sidestep, Spell Focus (necromancy), Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus (autumn sickle, ray of decay)
Skills Acrobatics +30, Climb +27, Diplomacy +31, Escape Artist +30, Knowledge (nature) +28, Perception +28, Sense Motive +28, Stealth +30, Survival +25
Languages Common, Elven, Sylvan; speak with animals, speak with plants
SQ autumn’s acquittal

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Autumn Bound (Su)

During spring months, the autumn hora queen gains the sickened condition.

Autumn’s Acquittal (Su)

As an immediate action after an autumn hora queen or an ally within 30 feet of the queen that it can see fails a saving throw, attack roll, or skill check, the queen grants an enhancement bonus to the saving throw based on the time of year. The bonus is +4 during the month of the autumnal equinox, +2 during the month before or after the autumnal equinox, and +1 during any time other than the vernal equinox month, during which this ability doesn’t function. The autumn hora queen can’t use this ability again for 1d4 rounds.

Spellcasting

The autumn hora queen casts spells as a 13th-level druid, but can’t swap out prepared spells to cast summon spells.

Stunning Beauty (Su)

This ability affects all humanoids within 30 feet of the autumn hora queen. Those who look directly at the queen must succeed on a DC 27 Fortitude save or be stunned for 1 minute and staggered for 1 hour. The queen can suppress or resume this ability as a free action. The save DC is Charisma-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate forests
Organization solitary or ring (1 + 1-24 autumn horai)
Treasure double (2 autumn sickles, fan of autumn, other treasure)

The Horai in the Greek myth were nymphs who danced around the Sun’s chariot, representing the seasons of the year and the hours of the day (the word “hour” derives from the Ancient Greek and Latin Hora). There were most commonly three of them: Thallo, Auxo, and Carpo (“Bloom” for Spring, “Increaser” for Summer, and “Reaper of Fruits” for Autumn). In other versions, they were the embodiment of the good effects of law and order (symbolized by Apollo) on the world of mortals, and their names were Eunomia (“Good Governance”), Dike (“Justice”), and Eirene (“Peace”). In Pathfinder’s rules, the stats for the Summer Hora and the Summer Hora Queen were given in the Faerie Bestiary: here we present horai for the remaining three seasons, and their respective Queens. Maybe the nymphs of Order could be discussed in a future issue of this magazine?
